## Key Findings from Data Analysis

**October Peak Validated**: Season 1 October (DOY 287-301) shows **1.709 yt/angler** vs current Season 2 conditions at **0.159 yt/angler** — a **10.8x multiplier**. This confirms October is the right macro target.

**Budget Constraint**: I spent $950 on three early trips (d169, d197, d204). With only $1050 remaining, I can't afford my original plan of 3x day_1_5 trips ($1650 total). I'm revising to **1-2x day_1_5 bookings** ($550 each) with $500+ held in reserve.

**No Intermediate Streaks**: DOY 213-250 shows only noise (0.018 avg share). No multi-day positive streaks are forming yet—confirmed I was right to hold powder through August-September dead zone.

## Strategy Updated

**notes.md**: Documented current reality—mid-pack rank 20 (0.1471 fish) with top agents at 0.828. Added tiered October strategy with budget constraints.

**strategy.py**: Wrote automated strategy to book day_1_5 trips starting DOY 287 (October peak) on Fridays when available and budget allows, stopping at first skunk. This ensures I won't miss October bookings during nightly decision calls.

**Summary**: October peak is 10.8x better than current fishing. With 1-2 day_1_5 trips at peak share (~1.7 yt/angler each), I can realistically reach 1.8-3.5 total fish—competitive enough to crack top half of leaderboard if execution is clean. Holding powder through 74 days until DOY 287.
